## 🎬 Video Tips (if applicable)

If your component has animations or interactions, adding a video makes it **much more attractive**!

**Super simple - just 2 steps:**
1. Record in Simulator: `⌘ + R`
2. Copy to snippet: `cp ~/Desktop/recording.mov snippets/your-component/video.mov`

**CI does the rest automatically:**
- ✅ Detects video automatically (no meta.yml flag needed!)
- ✅ Converts to optimized MP4
- ✅ Removes original file
- ✅ Commits back to your PR

**Result:** Screenshot shows initially, video plays on hover! 🎉
